settings.editor: Easy-going houseplants, handmade planters and the tools to keep them thriving, delivered from our greenhouse to your door.

image.alt: The greenhouse with benches of young plants

settings.editor: Every plant spends at least eight weeks on our benches before it ships, so it arrives acclimatised, rooted and ready. We pot in peat-free compost, wrap in paper and include a care card written for that exact plant.

settings.title: “The calathea arrived looking better than in the photos, and the care card actually answered my questions.”

settings.editor: Use the code WELCOME10 at checkout. It works on everything, from tiny pothos to the big fig.

settings.title: A small greenhouse with a big soft spot for plants

settings.editor: We started Fernwood in a borrowed polytunnel with forty pothos cuttings. Today we grow over two hundred varieties, still by hand.

image.alt: The greenhouse with benches of young plants

settings.editor:
A plant should arrive healthy, potted in good soil and with honest advice about where it will be happy. That's it. We would rather sell you a snake plant that thrives in your hallway than a fern that sulks.

Everything we ship is grown or finished in our greenhouse, packed in paper and card, and covered by a 30-day promise.

settings.description_text: Eight weeks on our benches before any plant ships.
Paper wraps, card boxes and compostable fillers.
Send a photo of a sad leaf and we'll reply within a day.

settings.title: Questions about a plant? Ask us.

settings.editor: We answer within a working day, usually much faster. Photos of struggling leaves welcome.
Orders placed before 1 pm ship the same day, Tuesday to Thursday, so plants never sit in a depot over the weekend.

products.name: Monstera Deliciosa
products.description:
The swiss cheese plant earns its holes slowly: give it bright, indirect light and it will add a new split leaf every few weeks through summer.

Ours are grown from cuttings, staked with a moss pole and potted in peat-free compost. Small is about 40 cm tall, medium 70 cm, large 110 cm.

reviews.author: Imogen Hart
reviews.content: Huge and healthy, and the moss pole was already in place. Two new leaves in the first month.

reviews.author: Dev Patel
reviews.content: Lovely plant, the medium is bigger than I expected.

products.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
products.description:
The fiddle leaf fig wants a spot by a bright window and to be left alone there. Turn it a quarter every month and it grows straight and full.

Supplied at around 90 cm in an 18 cm nursery pot, ready to drop into a planter.
products.short_description: A sculptural statement for a bright room.

reviews.author: Rosa Lin
reviews.content: Not a single dropped leaf after the move. Packed brilliantly.

products.name: Snake Plant
products.description:
Possibly the most forgiving plant there is: low light, forgotten waterings and dry air are all fine.

Upright striped leaves around 50 cm tall, in a 14 cm nursery pot.

products.name: Golden Pothos
products.description:
Trailing heart-shaped leaves splashed with gold. Let it tumble from a shelf or train it up a pole.

A full 15 cm pot with vines around 40 cm long.
products.short_description: The trailing plant everyone can keep alive.

products.name: Calathea Orbifolia
products.description:
Round, silver-striped leaves that fold up at night. Calatheas like humidity, filtered water and no direct sun.

About 45 cm tall in a 17 cm pot.

reviews.author: Tom Becker
reviews.content: Gorgeous. Followed the care card to the letter and it's happy so far.

products.name: Terracotta Pot
products.description:
Hand-thrown terracotta with a drainage hole and a matching saucer. The clay breathes, so roots stay healthy and soil dries evenly.

Made by a family pottery that has worked the same clay for three generations.

products.name: Speckled Ceramic Planter
products.description:
A wide stoneware planter with a speckled satin glaze and a cork plug in the drainage hole, so you choose whether it drains.

Fits an 18 cm nursery pot. 21 cm wide, 19 cm tall.

products.name: Macramé Hanging Planter
products.description:
Knotted by hand from undyed recycled cotton, with a wooden ring for hanging. Holds pots up to 18 cm.

About 95 cm long. Ceiling hook included.

products.name: Brass Watering Can
products.description:
A long, narrow spout reaches under leaves straight to the soil. Solid brass that darkens to a soft patina over time.

1 litre. Rinse and dry after use.

reviews.author: Mara Quinn
reviews.content: Beautiful and actually practical. The spout is perfect for the fern on the top shelf.

products.name: Organic Plant Food
products.description:
A gentle liquid feed made from seaweed and plant extracts. Add a capful to your watering can once a fortnight from spring to autumn.

500 ml, enough for about 50 feeds.

products.name: Pruning Shears
products.description:
Sharp carbon-steel blades for clean cuts on stems and leaves, with a locking catch and oiled-walnut handles.

Small enough for indoor plants, strong enough for the balcony.

products.name: Starter Gift Box
products.description: A snake plant, a hand-thrown terracotta pot and a bottle of plant food, packed in a gift box with a handwritten card.
products.short_description: The easiest plant, the right pot, the food to keep it going.
